Your screenshot fits the cause we already suspected. It doesn't point to a new bug, though this time it was the design bar that filled the page, not the whole design surface. That points to the same redirect. I've confirmed the steps below in `server/main.js` but haven't reproduced them.

1. **The design had lost its branch.** When a design is merged into main, Prelude removes its branch and worktree. So an existing design is back to being served from the project's own address (`/f/borrower-portal/d/loan-offers`), the same as a design that never had a branch.
2. **Typing made a new branch.** Keeping your draft is a POST, and a POST makes the design's branch if it has none (`server/main.js:656`).
3. **The next refresh was sent elsewhere and landed in the wrong place.** From then on, every GET at that address is redirected to the worktree's address (`server/main.js:662`). The design bar's refresh (`…/preview/bar`) comes back from that other address, so Koda drops it into the main page area instead of the bar's own slot. That's what filled your screen.

Any part of the page that refreshes itself at that address can do this until it's fixed.

The fix belongs in Prelude's server, not in this design, so I haven't changed it here:
- When a refresh asks for a design's page at the project's address, answer it in place from the worktree, as POSTs already are, instead of redirecting.
- Stop making a branch just to keep a draft, since drafts are only saved on this machine.

The open "New session doesn't work" question may be the same redirect.

I've added this report to the open question in `NOTES.md`. Do you want me to start a fix session for it?
